Built from the Rhino model DIRIYAH GATE II INDOOR ARENA COMPLEX – MOCKUP_1.3dm (mm). Heights are mm above the underside of the base plates (Rhino Z +). The surfaces were meshed for the web: the M12 threaded rods are shown as plain Ø12 cylinders, all carried up through the strut channel grid to +8,035 (in the Rhino file 228 of the 240 rods stop short of it) and the small fixings are simplified. Stone specifications are from the Royal Lobby module types schedule.
